title: Hearty Umami Mediterranean Chicken Tagine
description: A savory and flavorful one-pot dish featuring chicken, vegetables, and aromatic spices, cooked to perfection in a claypot. This recipe is diabetic-friendly and packed with umami flavor.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a claypot over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until it is translucent and starting to caramelize.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly to prevent burning.
Add the chicken to the claypot and cook until it is browned on all sides.
Add the chopped chive, thyme, paprika, salt, and pepper to the claypot and stir to combine.
Pour in the chicken broth and bring the mixture to a simmer.
Reduce the heat to low and cook, covered, for 30 minutes, or until the chicken is cooked through and the sauce has thickened.
Serve the tagine hot, garnished with additional chopped chive if desired.
